summary: LEGION-75 round 2 test at PR https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/1035, code commit 98c5ebf21c8e2886da1928e2189bb3f95ea7ba7d, branch head f9e5793a9ce5e239666ffc04e406481969c3af89: all six items pass. The checked-in test at the PR head gives `Results: 33 passed, 0 failed` exit 0 (the working-tree script blob 4c213ed8 equals 98c5ebf2's). Both blocking findings from review 5191040117 are fixed and reproduced by hand in fresh mktemp -d repos using only release-push.sh: an unreachable origin now exits 1 with the ::error:: sentence and a one-line job summary, and a modify/delete conflict (main deleted the manifest) aborts, exits 1 naming the manifest as a real divergence, leaves no rebase in progress and the working-tree manifest intact (42 bytes, 1.0.1), origin untouched. Round 1's Cases 1 and 2 still behave, and main's extra manifest edit (`.description`) survives the resolution. GIT_EDITOR=true is still on `git rebase --continue`, the jq result lands via `$manifest.tmp` + mv, and the gate checks `git cat-file -e HEAD:<manifest>`. Tests run 34765902884 is green on all four jobs at 98c5ebf2 with the same 33/0 line. PR is MERGEABLE / BLOCKED (awaiting review); no rebase.
environment: git 2.43.0, jaq 2.3.0 (runner: jq 1.7, agrees per CI step log). Hand reproductions deliberately did NOT export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM (only the test file does), so the script ran under this box's real git config.

prBody: Not edited this round (LEGION-90: every body edit re-runs the Tests suite); evidence lives here.
productionVerification: Unchanged from round 1: nothing under packages/ changes, so merging triggers no release; the production `Push version bump` step with the new push-main first runs on the next Release Packages run.
observations: The implementer's trickyParts names the opposite modify/delete shape (bump commit deletes the manifest, main modifies it) as unguarded but unreachable because `release-push.sh tag` always stages a modification. Agreed on reachability; not tested, not a finding.
In 2a the two `fatal:` blocks before the ::error:: are git's own push/fetch stderr, not the script's — expected and useful context in a run log.
scratchScripts: /tmp/legion-75-r2.sh plus one inline jq-shim experiment — throwaway, each under mktemp -d and removed; not committed.
noProjectWideRuns: No formatter, biome, tsc, or bun test run; only release-push.test.sh, the scratch reproductions, one grep of the script, YAML-free reads, and legion gh reads.
